Random beacon spot-checks deter sybil farming: a VRF beacon typically selects 5% of identities per epoch, and proofs are due within 2 epochs.

Verification relies on 7 jurors; a single whisper from any observer triggers a deeper audit, while absence freezes rewards 6 epochs.

A second absence triggers a 50% slash, so 1,000 clones locking 120,000 units expect a loss of 6,000 per round, and the rule, hard as basalt, revokes the ivory seal.
